sections.section_title: GPIO port input data register (GPIOx_IDR) (x = A to H)
sections.text_helper: Section 11.4.5 "GPIO port input data register (GPIOx_IDR) (x = A to H)" in chapter 11 (General-purpose I/Os (GPIO)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 350.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x10
Reset value: 0x0000 XXXX
Bits 31:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 IDy: Port x input data I/O pin y (y = 15 to 0)
These bits are read-only. They contain the input value of the corresponding I/O port.
Note: The bit is reserved and must be kept to reset value when the corresponding I/O is not
available on the selected package.
